item.ptxt: Brake fluid is extremely damaging to painted surfaces.
If brake fluid contacts a painted surface, immediately wipe it off and flush the surface with water thoroughly.
The rear axle bolts are pre-coated with friction stabilizer. If these bolts are reused, they may work loose.
Never reuse the rear axle bolts.

attention3.ptxt: Rear axle bushing is not individually replaceable. Replace rear axle if the bushing is defective.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove rear wheels.
Remove rear fender linings.
For headlight auto leveling model, remove vehicle height sensor from rear axle.
Remove rear brake disc dust cover for each of right and left rear wheels.
Remove parking brake cable clamp (1) from rear axle at each of right and left sides.
Remove E-rings (2) and disconnect brake pipe clamp (3) at each of right and left sides.
While supporting rear axle at both ends using floor jacks, remove right and left rear shock absorber lower bolts, and then remove rear coil springs from rear axle.
Remove right and left rear axle bolts (1), and then remove rear axle from vehicle by lowering the jacks gradually.
Place rear axle on floor jacks and align its front ends with mounting positions in vehicle body.
Insert new right and left rear axle bolts (1) and tighten them temporarily.
Install coil springs and rear shock absorbers to rear axle.
Connect brake pipes to rear axle, and then install E-rings.
Install parking brake cables to rear axle.
Install rear brake disc dust cover for each of right and left sides.
For headlight auto leveling model, install vehicle height sensor to rear axle.
Install rear wheels.
Lower hoist and bounce vehicle up and down several times to stabilize suspension.
Tighten shock absorber lower bolts to specified torque.
Tighten rear axle bolts to specified torque.
Install rear fender linings.
Check that rear brakes are free from dragging and proper braking is obtained.
Check all installed parts for brake fluid leakage.
Check rear wheel alignment.
